custom_function_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_device_datacenter(p_device_id integer, p_rack_position character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_cabinet_number character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_power_consumption_rated numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_cooling_zone character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE devices 
    SET config = jsonb_set(
        COALESCE(config, '{}'::jsonb),
        '{datacenter}',
        COALESCE(config->'datacenter', '{}'::jsonb) || 
        jsonb_build_object(
            'rack_position', p_rack_position,
            'cabinet_number', p_cabinet_number,
            'power_consumption_rated', p_power_consumption_rated,
            'cooling_zone', p_cooling_zone
        )
    )
    WHERE id = p_device_id;
END;
$function$

views.definition:
SELECT d.id,
    d.name,
    d.location,
    dc.name AS category_name,
    ((d.config -> 'lifecycle'::text) ->> 'installation_date'::text) AS installation_date,
    ((d.config -> 'lifecycle'::text) ->> 'warranty_expiry'::text) AS warranty_expiry,
    ((d.config -> 'lifecycle'::text) ->> 'critical_level'::text) AS critical_level,
    ((d.config -> 'datacenter'::text) ->> 'rack_position'::text) AS rack_position,
        CASE
            WHEN ((((d.config -> 'lifecycle'::text) ->> 'warranty_expiry'::text))::date <= CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'Expired'::text
            WHEN ((((d.config -> 'lifecycle'::text) ->> 'warranty_expiry'::text))::date <= (CURRENT_DATE + '30 days'::interval)) THEN 'Expiring Soon'::text
            ELSE 'Valid'::text
        END AS warranty_status
   FROM (devices d
     LEFT JOIN device_categories dc ON ((d.category_id = dc.id)))
  WHERE (d.is_deleted = false);
